title: A Bit About Me
intro: I like building things end to end and understanding what happens beyond the code itself, from how the pieces fit together to how a system behaves once it's deployed and being used. I tend to learn best by building, breaking things, fixing them, and gradually turning an idea into something real.
body: That curiosity goes beyond software too. I've taught myself enough about cars to replace a BMW steering rack without a mechanic, and I enjoy tinkering with hardware for the same reason. Outside of that, I spend time trail running, training for endurance events, playing video games, and reading science fiction. I like figuring out how things work, pushing myself a little further than last time, and having something tangible to show for the effort.
conclusion: If you'd like to talk about a role, a project, or anything else, please don't hesitate to use the contact form. I'm always happy to hear from people.
